explanation: Reverse the entire string, then reverse each space-delimited word in place. This restores the character order inside words while reversing their order and preserving spaces.
timeComplexity: O(n) time for the in-place method.
spaceComplexity: O(1) method workspace; the wrapper additionally copies its string input.
